entries.title: Tell us your Meals on Wheels experience
entries.summary: Mountain State Spotlight is reporting on the challenges faced by West Virginians who receive or want to receive Meals on Wheels.  Reporter Erin Beck has previously reported that over 1,000 seniors across the state are on waitlists to receive meals delivered to their homes, due to lack of state funding.
